title: evaluator's result
description: What the evaluator writes as it ends, at <round>/evaluator.json: for each necessary condition of its best practice that its trial reached, good with the lines that meet it, or more with good_when, from one trial as the deliverable's people.

result.description: The word it gives as it ends: evaluated, once each condition has its answer.

good.description: Each condition that the deliverable meets, with the lines that meet it.

condition.description: The condition's ID in the best practice, such as N2.

lines.description: Each line of the deliverable that meets it, word for word as it stands, so that a reader checks the answer by reading them.

more.description: Each condition that the deliverable doesn't yet meet, with what would make it good.

condition.description: The condition's ID in the best practice, such as N2.

good_when.description: What the deliverable's people get once it's good, in their terms, never how to make it, as the generator holds the sources and decides the mend.
